type Pair[K comparable, V any] struct {
	Key K
	Val V
}

func (p *Pair[K, V]) Swap(other Pair[K, V], a, b, c int, _ string) (x int, err error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func Map[T, U any](xs []T, f func(T) U) []U {
	out := make([]U, 0, len(xs))
	for _, x := range xs {
		out = append(out, f(x))
	}
	return out
}

func variadic(prefix string, args ...any) {}

func (Pair[K, V]) Empty() {}

func shadow(len int, new string) {}
